findings.claim: In account-ui, error-invalid-multivalued-size was changed from i18next {{N}} placeholders to MessageFormat {N}/choice syntax. account-ui uses default i18next interpolation without i18next-icu, so the string renders with raw placeholders.

verifier.reason: js/apps/account-ui/maven-resources/theme/keycloak.v3/account/messages/messages_en.properties:188 defines error-invalid-multivalued-size with MessageFormat syntax (Attribute {0} must have at least {1} and at most {2} {2,choice,0#values|1#value|1<values}.) instead of i18next {{N}} placeholders used by the other error-* keys and existing community translations. Because js/apps/account-ui/src/i18n.ts:25-47 initializes i18next with default interpolation and no i18next-icu plugin (nor is it in js/apps/account-ui/package.json), setUserProfileServerError in js/libs/ui-shared/src/user-profile/utils.ts:62-84 renders the string with raw placeholders.

findings.claim: In the Lithuanian bundles messages_lt.properties (account totpStep1 and login loginTotpStep1), the value was replaced with the Italian text 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:' instead of Lithuanian.

verifier.reason: Both Lithuanian message bundles contain the Italian string 'Installa una delle seguenti applicazioni sul tuo cellulare:' instead of Lithuanian at themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/account/messages/messages_lt.properties:101 (totpStep1) and themes/src/main/resources-community/theme/base/login/messages/messages_lt.properties:71 (loginTotpStep1), while surrounding keys in both files are in Lithuanian.

findings.claim: The method name 'santizeAnchors' is misspelled; it should be 'sanitizeAnchors'.

verifier.reason: The claim does not specify a file location, access to change.patch and the external .git worktree metadata is denied as outside the allowed workspace directories, and shell/search/subagent tools are unavailable or blocked, preventing inspection of the patched files.

findings.claim: POLICY_SOME_HTML, POLICY_NO_HTML and HTML_TAGS use constant naming but are non-static instance fields rebuilt per instance. This is inconsistent with the private static final ANCHOR_PATTERN.

verifier.reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java, POLICY_SOME_HTML (lines 58-61), POLICY_NO_HTML (line 63), and HTML_TAGS (line 139) use UPPER_SNAKE_CASE constant naming but are package-private non-static instance fields rebuilt on every instantiation (e.g., per file in ThemeVerifierMojo.java:51). This is inconsistent with ANCHOR_PATTERN at VerifyMessageProperties.java:145, which is declared private static final.

findings.claim: The commons-text dependency version 1.13.0 is outdated compared with 1.15.0.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/pom.xml:80-85 declares org.apache.commons:commons-text at version 1.13.0 (misc/theme-verifier/pom.xml:83), added for HTML entity unescaping in misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:93,130. Version 1.13.0 is outdated compared with the released 1.15.0 version (which also updates transitive commons-lang3 past CVE-2025-48924), though impact is limited to this non-deployed build-time Maven plugin.

findings.claim: The theme verifier anchor check does not fail when a translation drops an anchor present in the source, so translations can lose links and still pass.

verifier.reason: In misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:150-162, santizeAnchors only loops while matcher.find() matches anchors in the translated value and never checks whether englishMatcher.find() still has unmatched anchors remaining from englishValue. Because verifySafeHtml at lines 88-112 performs no other anchor presence check, a translation that drops an anchor tag from the source still passes verification.

findings.claim: The sanitize/unescape/strip-comment/trim-diff pipeline and the commons-text dependency duplicate functionality available through OWASP's HtmlChangeListener.

verifier.reason: misc/theme-verifier/src/main/java/org/keycloak/themeverifier/VerifyMessageProperties.java:92-112 (with matching unescape at :130) calls single-arg policy.sanitize(value), unescapes HTML4 via StringEscapeUtils.unescapeHtml4, strips '<!-- -->', and diffs trimmed substrings solely to detect and report stripped HTML, which is the only usage of commons-text added in misc/theme-verifier/pom.xml:80-85. OWASP's PolicyFactory.sanitize(String, HtmlChangeListener, CTX) already reports discarded tags and attributes directly through HtmlChangeListener, making both this pipeline and the commons-text dependency redundant.
